Wow, there seems to be lots of treasures that can\nbe sold for a crazy price too here...Tee-hee...
Wait!\nDon't you ever think that stealing from a phantom\nthief like me would impress me!
Ohh, there you are!! D-don't accuse me! They were\non the ground and I was just picking them up!\nAnyway, everything here, you stole them right?!
They have been there inside the item that\ncaught m...oops! I mean that contained me...
The thing that I wanna get the most now is...\nSomething that belongs to Mr. Zarth, the Halloween\nKing of this world...Tee-hee...
What is it?
Come and get me if you wanna know!
Hey, waittt!
Oh my?!\nHow come you guys are here?!
Tee-hee...Among the items in Zarth's Mansion,\nthere's an item that can create a clone of\nsomeone...
So I just made use of it...
You can find me behind this door.\nIf you wanna open it, get the keys from them,\ntee-hee-hee...
Argh! Either way we were told to do something with\nthat thief! I think this is gonna be troublesome.
All right, let's hurry and collect the keys or\nwhatever that thing said!
Jacky? You seem different tho...\nAh! You're...the fake Jacky!\nHurry up and pass us the key now!!
Oh my?!\nI see, so she wants to do it the hard way...\nFine then! Finish them off!
Alright, just give up and hand us the key already!
Arghh, that was fast...Umm?\nThis is...
"You have obtained Wooden Key."
Ah! You're...Olant! Hey, you!\nHurry up and pass us the key now!
What? Just this one?\nThat's so uncool and kinda boring...\nWe've got no time to waste! Finish it quickly!
So, do you still wanna fight?\nYou'd better give up and give us the key now!
Ah! Hey, waittt!\nI told ya to leave the keyyy!!
"You have obtained Iron Key."
Hey, we've come to see you!
Uh? Finally!\nI thought you won't come because you guys took\nquite a while.
Just shut the heck up!\nAlso, there's no such thing as a clone creator!\nThey were all just monsters in disguise!
T-there's nothing I can do about it!\nI didn't really wanna touch the things here!
Wait, what?\nI thought you came here to steal stuff, no?
Yes? Um...ah...uh...Anyway, thanks to you guys,\nthe next trick I've prepared won't go to waste.\nTee-hee-hee...
Whaaaat?! Another troublesome thing?
Well, please don't say that...\nYou just need to deal with some options to go on\na date with me, I repeat, "options"♪
Alright then, please don't make a lady wait\ntoo long!
Lady, my ass!\nCall yourself a lady only when you become an\nelegant woman like me...
What? If you have something to say just spit it\nout!
Alright whatever, let's go now!
Uh, um...?\nSeems like some kind of questions.\nCould they be the options she was talking about?
Eek!! Y-you're the fake Potumkin...But your size\nis just so wrong! Do you even really want\nto trick us? Well, whatever, give us the key...
Seems like he wants to do it the hard way.\nFine! It's your time to shine!\nI'll sit back and enjoy the show.
Uh, um...?\nSeems like some kind of questions.\nCould they be the options she was talking about?
Oh, finally you're back to your original size.\nWell then, you have the key right?\nHand it over...
Whoa!\nAh! Waiiit!\nOh well, I guess it's fine since we got the key.
"You have obtained Dream Key."
A group of Potums were having a race.\nA Potum managed to instantly overtake the Potums\nin 4th-6th place.
The Potum overtaking the Potum in 4th place would\nbe in 3rd place. If you think it is correct, go to\nthe Gold Door. If not, go to the Silver Door.
There are 30 Crystas.\nUse them to create a formula.\nYou can use up to 30 Crystas.
O+O = O×O, You can put in the same number of\nCrystas in O. If it is possible, go to the\nGold Door, if not go to the Silver Door.
5 happy fellows are playing hide-and-seek;\nYou, Jeila,\nJacky, Olant, and Potumkin.
2 fellows got found. That means 2 fellows are\nstill hiding. If you think it is correct, go to\nthe Gold Door, if not, go to the Silver Door.
Olant and Potumkin used a total of 100 magic gems\nto make toys. Olant used 90 more magic gems than\nPotumkin to make his toy.
Is it correct that Potumkin used 10 magic gems to\nmake his toy? If you think it is correct, go to\nthe Gold Door, if not, go to the Silver Door.
There was a monster among the items Zarth brought\nhome from another world. It grows and doubles\nevery minute.
The room became full in 1 hour. If it began with\n2 monsters, it would be full in 31 minutes or\nmore→ Gold Door; 30 minutes or less→ Silver Door.
Zoe has a magic microwave. Using 50 gems for 3\nminutes, or 150 gems for 1 minute produces the\nsame amount of magic energy for heating food.
How long will it take to heat food if 100 gems\nare used? If you think it's 2 minutes, go to the\nGold Door, if not go to the Silver Door.
There are pets in a house. It's a Coryn apart from\nthe other 2. It's a Hound apart from the other 2,\nand it's a Potum apart from the other 2.
How many pets in total are there in the house?\nIf you think it's 3, go to the Gold Door, and if\nyou think there are more, go to the Silver Door.
Jeila brought 333 magic gems.\nShe said, "You can take as many as you want!"
You took 128 gems from the 333 gems. How many gems\ndo you have now? If you think it's 150 or more, go\nto the Gold Door, if not go to the Silver Door.
Hmm, seems like the door won't open if we don't\nget all the 3 keys...
The door should open with these keys...\nHmm?!
Seems like we did it.\nAlright, let's go catch that rat!
Welcome, welcome!\nSeems like you're in time for the show.\nI'm glad you made it!
Hey! Don't you realize that you can no longer run\nfrom us now? How could you still talk with that\nattitude! C'mon, just surrender yourself!
What are you talking about?\nSo far, you've only had the appetizer...\nThe main dish is just about to be served!
Actually, it'd be nice to see you fight Mr. Zarth,\nbut let's just save him for dessert!
S-so you still wanna fight?! Fine, bring it on!!
Well, do your job!
HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Phantom Wisp!!
HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat all monsters!!
Wait, is it over?
Oh? You guys are all here?
Yeah! We were chasing out the monsters in each\nmansion, but strangely, nothing got stolen...\nSo we wonder what's actually going on.
Hey, what's all this??
A-as a matter of fact...
...So you're saying that you got locked in one of\nthe items I bought from another world?
Yup...I got caught in a trap\nin the mansion I sneaked into...\nMy minions got locked inside it too...
Then I was freed here, and since I'm a phantom\nthief, I think I should at least steal something\nto save my face...
But, nothing was stolen tho?
Nothing has gone missing from my place either.\nWhat did you actually intend to steal?
Um...as I got locked inside the thing for a while,\nI was kinda scared to reach out for anything...\nSo, I thought of stealing Mr. Zarth's title.
My title?
The "Halloween King"...! Since you have traveled\nto various worlds, that title of yours must be\nmore valuable than any treasure...!
But that's just what I call myself though.
A-are you serious...?
You've completely targeted the wrong thing.
Phantom Wisp right? It's true that it's just him\ncalling himself the Halloween King, but we still\ndon't know how other people think about it, right?
That's right!\nMother and I think that title suits father nicely!\nHe is the "Halloween King"!!
Even if you go around telling people you're the\nHalloween King, nobody will buy it.
U-umm...\nOkay, I lost...
Well, it's all right!\nYour plot seems to have kept the guests amused\nanyway!
Also, I think we have settled the case,\nso please take this!
As I've also caused trouble for you two,\nI apologize.
Well, since we've got the reward, we're okay with\nit tho, but...?!
?? Anything wrong?
Perhaps Zarth has forgiven you, but!
How dare you interrupt our plan to welcome the\nguests!
Are you ready to pay for what you did, pom?
W-wait a sec!\nIt was almost a happy ending for me tho! Are you\ntelling me that you're not gonna forgive me?!
Who cares whether it's a happy ending or not!!
We wanna teach you a lesson!!
You screwed up everything we've prepared, pom!!
Sorry! I'm really sorry!\nI know I was wrong!!
You're here!\nDoes it mean that my training partner is...
Yup, it's the guest.
I bet you know how good the guest is.\nDo your best!
Be serious or else I won't forgive you, pom!
Well, go and teach her a proper lesson!
Do your best for the reward...Oops, I mean do\nyour best to settle things nicely!
Hmm, you made quite interesting moves!
You kinda made a mistake at the end.
We should review your performance, pom!
Ooh, hi!\nThanks for helping with the coaching, sorry about\nthat.
Oh right, I think soon I'll find out about\nyour world.
Really Mr. Zarth?!
Yup! And do you think it's better to lock you\nagain in the thing when you go back just like when\nyou got here?
What...?\nErr, no, please don't...\nJust let me go home normally.
It's okay!! Don't be afraid!!
It's not okay!\nI didn't get in there because I liked it!!\nAre you angry?!
Oh, he's always like that.\nIt's gonna be problematic later if you don't say\nno properly, you know?
A-anyway, Father!\nHurry up and give the reward to the guest!
Right! We've troubled you again.\nPlease take this as a token of my gratitude.
Difficulty: Hard has been added to BOSS: Phantom Wisp.
Difficulty: Very Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Phantom Wisp.
Oh, it's you! Have you got a minute?
You know the pranks that we'd been preparing\nso hard this time all went to waste...
But, things are pretty much back to normal now,\nso Zoe and Jeila are gonna make us sweets!
But then I feel bad if I just let them prepare\neverything...
So I want you to collect the ingredients.\nHmm? Us? Oh, no we can't since we're kinda busy\ncoaching Phantom Wisp.
Okay!
I'm kinda busy!
Thanks! I knew you would say yes!\nAlright, here's the memo of the ingredients you\nneed to collect!
O-oh, really?\nFine then, but please help me when you're free!
How is it? So far so good?
Hmm.\nWell, I'll just be more patient, it's worth\nwaiting anyway. Go on then and thanks again!
Let's see...Yaaas! It's all good!\nThey can make us sweets now!\nHere, your reward!
Not enough [ffff64]sweets[ffffff] that Jacky wants...
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.

Oh! It's you! Too bad we couldn't show you the\npranks we'd prepared this time. They would have\nsurprised and made you scream!
But, Zoe and Jeila are throwing a party to cheer\nus up! So I wanna be useful to them too!
I've gathered some ingredients, but...\nI still need your help to collect the ingredients\nthat are hard for me to collect.
Well, okay.
No way.
Hooray! Thanks!
Okay, maybe it's kinda difficult, but I want you\nto collect the ingredients written here!
O-o-okay, I got it. \nI shouldn't rely on others all the time...\nBut please help me when you feel like doing it!
How is it? Not yet?\nWell, those ingredients are difficult to get...\nI'll be waiting patiently then!
You've collected everything? Hooray!\nThanks!
Zoe will be happy to see this!\nHere is your reward, please take it!
Not enough [ffff64]sweets[ffffff] that Olant wants...

Oh! It's you, pom!\nToo bad we couldn't show you the pranks we'd\nprepared for you this time, pom.
Zoe and Jeila said that they would throw a party\nto make up for it this time, pom.\nBut...
Don't tell anyone I told you this, but Zarth said\nhe'd secretly collect ingredients for the sweets\ntoo, pom. However, I'm kinda worried, pom.
So I want you to collect the ingredients too just\nin case he doesn't collect any, pom.
I guess it's fine...
I'm busy now!
Thanks pom!\nI knew you'd say yes, pom!
Well, I've jotted down the ingredients I want\nyou to collect on this paper, pom.\nAlso, please keep it secret from Zarth, pom!
Pom pom pomm~...Well, I can only hope that Zarth\ncollects them properly then, pom...\nIf you change your mind, please do it for me, pom.
Are you still struggling, pom?\nPlease, please, do it extra carefully so as not to\nget noticed by Zarth, pom!
You've collected all of them, pom?! Hooray, pom!\nYou're reliable as always, pom!
Make sure to keep it secret from Zarth, pom!\nI'll ask you again when I need help, pom!
